missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Остров' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Этот' is the agreeing determiner, and 'красивый' is the predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Остров' is the accusative object of 'увидеть'; this inanimate masculine noun matches the nominative. 'Этот' agrees in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Острова' is genitive showing whose shore it is. 'Маяк' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Острову' is the dative form after 'к' to show movement toward the island. 'Корабль' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Острове' is the prepositional form after 'на' to mark location. 'Неделю' is the accusative of duration.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Островом' is instrumental after 'над' to mean above the island. 'Птицы' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Острова' is genitive after 'до' to express reaching the island. 'Быстро' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Остров' is nominative as the subject of 'находится'. 'В океане' is prepositional marking location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of quantity. 'Островов' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'В этом море' is prepositional marking location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Острова' is the nominative plural with end stress. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'далеко' is the predicate adverb.
